entities.summary: Mikhail Aleksandrovich Ilinich, better known by the pseudonym of Mikhail Oktan was a Russian Nazi collaborator during World War II who served as de facto mayor of the city of Oryol under Nazi occupation, as well as an important Russian collaborationist in Bobruisk. He was active in Russia, Belarus, and Poland.
